signIn.onboardingHtml:
Use your ArcGIS account to sign in to MapMaker.

If you don't have an ArcGIS account, see How do I get an account?

strings.basemapsIntro: Select a basemap to refine the color of your map.
strings.styleNumericColorSizeHint: two numbers together, e.g. depth as color, magnitude as size
strings.styleCategoricalSizeHint: e.g. species as color, height as size
strings.sumTypeSize: Each point colored by {color}, sized by {size}.
strings.sketchToolsHint: Draw with the tools at the top of the map. Select a sketch to give it a pop-up, color and size.
strings.manySelected: {n} sketches selected: color and size change them all. Select just one to edit its pop-up.
strings.styledFillHint: This fill is drawn as it is, so it has no colors or outline to set.
